concept.concept: A minimal line-art mountain range with falling leaf silhouettes and the text 'Peak Foliage Chaser' in worn vintage lettering.
concept.audience: Hikers, leaf-peepers, outdoor recreation adults aged 25-60
concept.rationale: Fall foliage hiking culture is a real and growing phenomenon with dedicated communities. Buying window aligns perfectly with early fall hike planning. 'Leaf peeper' is an established and affectionate self-identifier. The vintage outdoor aesthetic is proven in POD. Lower design saturation than generic hiking shirts and strong identity-badge appeal for this passionate niche.

design.image_prompt: Flat vector illustration of a minimal mountain range with sharp angular peaks in solid black. Overlaid are falling leaf silhouettes in burnt orange, golden yellow, and deep crimson descending across the composition. Single centered design on a cream background with generous margins. Solid color blocks, no gradients, no airbrush shading, no photorealism. Bold simple shapes with clean sharp edges in screen-print aesthetic. Readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.text_on_design: Peak Foliage Chaser in bold worn vintage serif lettering, arched above the mountain peaks
design.style: flat vector illustration, screen-print aesthetic, limited palette: black, burnt orange, golden yellow, deep crimson, cream background

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Peak Foliage Chaser' is a generic descriptive expression combining common outdoor/nature vocabulary with no known trademark associations. The visual elements — minimal line-art mountains and falling leaf silhouettes — are generic nature imagery widely used in the public domain. The worn vintage serif lettering style is a common design treatment not associated with any specific brand or protected trade dress. No celebrity, team, character, brand, or protected slogan references are present. The design is cleared for print-on-demand use.

image_verdict.reason: Clean, original flat-design illustration featuring stylized black mountain silhouettes with autumn leaves in red, orange, and gold tones on a neutral background. No IP concerns, no text, no identifiable characters or logos. Composition is simple and well-suited for garment printing.

listing.title: Peak Foliage Chaser T-Shirt | Hiking & Autumn Mountain Tee
listing.description: Designed for those who chase brilliant leaf colors across mountain peaks. This tee features minimal line-art mountain silhouettes with delicate falling leaves and vintage-style lettering that celebrates autumn hiking season. Perfect for hikers, trail enthusiasts, and anyone who marks their year by peak foliage forecasts. Ideal gift for outdoor recreation adults aged 25-60. Comfortable 100% cotton construction, available in multiple colors and sizes. Great for casual wear, weekend trips, or as a gift for the outdoor enthusiast in your life.
